question: Full form of UPU is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Universal Postal Union**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Universal Postal Union (UPU)** is a specialized agency of the United Nations established to coordinate and promote international postal services.
 
• It was founded on **9 October 1874** through the signing of the Treaty of Bern.
 
• The UPU headquarters is located in **Bern, Switzerland**.
 
• The organization sets **standards for international postal services** and promotes cooperation among member countries.
 
• The UPU consists of **192 member countries** (as of 2023) and works to ensure universal access to postal services across the globe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Structure:**

 
 
• The UPU has four main components: the **Congress, the Council of Administration, the Postal Operations Council, and the International Bureau**.
 
• The **Congress** is the supreme authority where member countries meet to decide on postal policies and strategies.
 
• The **International Bureau** serves as the secretariat and headquarters of the UPU.
 
 
 
• **Other Postal Organizations:**
 
 
• In addition to the UPU, regional postal organizations like the **Asia-Pacific Postal Union (APPU)** and the **European Committee for Postal Regulation (CERP)** contribute to the development of postal services.
 
• These organizations focus on regional cooperation and address specific challenges faced by postal services in their respective areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Celebration of World Post Day:**

 
 
• **World Post Day** is celebrated annually on **9 October** to commemorate the establishment of the UPU.
 
• The day highlights the importance of postal services in connecting people and businesses globally.
